human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Prevent false evidence-inconsistency findings when allow/deny/review decisions belong to different execution scopes, while preserving true contradictions inside the same scope and decision domain.
human_pressure.why_now: The real EverRun dogfood exposed the cost of run-wide decision aggregation. Ailuros core has the same class of risk in its evidence inconsistency rule.
do_not_misread: Do not whitelist specific decision sequences such as accept/continue/human_review.
Do not add EverRun pack or iteration semantics.
Do not suppress true same-scope contradictions.

machine_core.goal: Group decision-consistency checks by canonical execution scope plus decision domain so different scopes do not contaminate each other.
red_lines: Do not weaken same-scope conflict detection.
Do not change unrelated signal severities.
invariants: Different explicit scope_ref values are independent governance subjects.
Unscoped decisions retain current run-level behavior.
Same-scope allow plus deny/block/fail remains inconsistent where the existing rule says so.

observable_effect.assertion: Cross-scope decisions no longer trigger false inconsistency while same-scope contradictory decisions still do.

proofs.assertion: Governance signal tests cover cross-scope non-conflict, same-scope conflict, and unscoped compatibility.

failure_semantics: Missing scope continues to aggregate at run scope.
Malformed scope is not trusted as a separation boundary.

steps.title: Carry scope on decisions
details: Ensure DecisionSummary exposes the explicit canonical scope needed by rule evaluation.

steps.title: Scope inconsistency grouping
details: Group by scope_ref and projected decision domain rather than domain alone.

steps.title: Prove true and false conflict cases
details: Add focused tests for different scopes, same scope, and unscoped compatibility.

acceptance: Cross-scope allow/deny combinations do not produce EVIDENCE_INCONSISTENCY.
Same-scope contradictory decisions still produce the signal.

must_check: Conflict grouping uses generic scope_ref plus decision domain.
No EverRun decision vocabulary appears in production logic.
reject_if: The implementation suppresses conflicts by hardcoded decision sequences.
Different producer concepts are added to core.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Signal and projection tests directly prove the production false-positive class exposed by dogfood.
